description: This file sets up a Streamlit-based web interface for a SQL database chatbot using LangChain and OpenAI models. It includes environment configuration, database connection setup, prompt templates, and functions for handling user queries and responses.

classes.name: traceable
classes.description: A decorator for tracing functions, imported from langsmith

methods.name: count_tokens
methods.description: Handles token counting and query processing with a prompt template, using LangChain callbacks and Streamlit for UI.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that runs the Streamlit app, managing chat state, user input, and displaying responses.
